title: Metal Gear
notes: Managed-content package bound by SHA-256 to one operator-supplied NES cartridge dump held in the console-managed object store; this repository ships no ROM and no emulator binary.
No controller, audio, video, save, or timing evidence exists for this title on any target, so the compatibility status stays unverified even though the frontend and core artifact hashes are recorded.

Mesen is GPL-3.0-or-later and requires content: it does not declare RETRO_ENVIRONMENT_SET_SUPPORT_NO_GAME (D-190). Utilities/orfanidis_eq.h and Libretro/MesenDB.txt carry no stated terms and block any redistribution claim, which is why distribution is owner-authorized-local.

Mesen component attribution: hqx and nes_ntsc and blip_buf under LGPL-2.1-or-later, Scale2x under GPL-2.0-or-later, xBRZ under GPL-3.0, the RetroArch-derived 2xSaI and SuperEagle filters under GPL-3.0-or-later, and miniz, stb_vorbis, md5, sha1, and the bundled LZMA SDK as public-domain grants.

The frontend and core hashes record one native aarch64 build observation on a Raspberry Pi 5. Neither artifact was signed, scanned, or built from a pinned toolchain, so they are not reproducible-build evidence.

Metal Gear is a trademark of Konami; the North American NES release carried Konami's Ultra Games label. No licence covers the content; the operator supplies a dump of a cartridge they hold and the console never redistributes it.
